description_en: You can call DescribeDcdnWafGroups to query a list of custom Web Application Firewall (WAF) rule groups
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnWafGroups查询自定义WAF规则组列表
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn describe-dcdn-waf-groups --biz-language zh --query-args RuleIds_:_100001,200002 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDcdnWafGroups

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- **en**: English. This is the default value.

- **zh**: Chinese
parameters.help_zh:
语言类型，将以此语言返回。取值范围：
- **en**：英文（默认）。
- **zh**：中文
parameters.name: language

parameters.help_en:
The query conditions in a JSON-serialized string. The format is as follows:
`QueryArgs={"PolicyIds":"Range of mitigation policy IDs","RuleIds":"Range of rule IDs","RuleNameLike":"Rule name","DomainNames":"Protected domain names","DefenseScenes":"waf_group","RuleStatus":"on","OrderBy":"GmtModified","Desc":"false"}`

> If you do not set this parameter, all mitigation rules are queried
parameters.help_zh:
查询条件，JSON序列化后的字符串。格式如下：
`QueryArgs={"PolicyIds":"防护策略ID范围","RuleIds":"防护规则ID范围","RuleNameLike":"防护规则名称","DomainNames":"防护域名","DefenseScenes":"waf_group","RuleStatus":"on","OrderBy":"GmtModified","Desc":"false"}`
>不传默认查询所有防护规则
parameters.name: query_args

parameters.help_en: The page number. The default value is **1**
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The default value is **20**
parameters.name: page_size
